node.statement: At each level define F_z(X,Y)=v_n(X)z_n(Y)-z_n(XY)+z_n(X)v_n(Y). Expanding g_n and using associativity of M_n tensor B gives the exact cocycle residual v_n(X)g_n(Y,Z)-g_n(XY,Z)+g_n(X,YZ)-g_n(X,Y)v_n(Z), which is the associator (v_n(X)v_n(Y))v_n(Z)-v_n(X)(v_n(Y)v_n(Z)); its norm is at most 2 epsilon||X||||Y||||Z|| for d+epsilon<=1/4. Substituting z=w_prime, using X D=D X entrywise and pi(D)=I, and applying the d-multiplicativity bound at each of the finitely many replacements yields ||F_(w_prime)(X,Y)-g_n(X,Y)||<=C_0(d^2+epsilon)||X||||Y||, where C_0 is universal because sum_j||A_j||||B_j||=1.
